user.title: Connect to Foundation Sunshine
user.description: Enter the Windows host running Sunshine. The default resolution is used for the virtual display created while the physical screen is off; you can change it later in the integration options.

data.protect_active_stream: Block screen-on while Moonlight is streaming (optional)

pair_pin.title: Enter the PIN in Sunshine
pair_pin.description:
Open {web_url}, enter **{pin}** on the PIN page (the device will be named MoonScreen), then tick the confirmation below and submit.

If no request is listed, wait a few seconds and refresh. {vdd_note}

data.confirm: I entered the PIN in Sunshine

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair MoonScreen
reauth_confirm.description: Sunshine no longer accepts the current client certificate. A new certificate will be created for {host} and you will need to enter another PIN in Sunshine.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Sunshine. Check the host, ports and firewall.
error.invalid_option: Resolution, FPS or poll interval is out of range.
error.invalid_pin: Wrong PIN or the pairing expired. A new PIN has been generated; please retry.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check the Sunshine log and try again.
error.pin_not_confirmed: The PIN has not been confirmed in Sunshine yet. Enter it and submit again.
error.confirm_required: Please tick the confirmation box first.

abort.already_configured: This Sunshine host is already configured.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing could not be started. Please retry.
abort.reauth_failed: The config entry to re-pair could not be found.
